execution_steps: 1. Ran the programmatic exact-rule_text matcher against the pool resolved in UBL-MODEL-001/VALUES-001/DOCTYPES-001: 27 of 29 UBL-PARSE-001 obligations matched exactly (dict-key equality). Spot-checked 4 pairs directly against the register to confirm byte-for-byte identity.

2. Investigated the 2 non-matching obligations. SAL-UBL-OBL-55B90386831BAA06 (default vs. prefixed namespace forms resolve identically): read reader.py's _to_node() and confirmed it copies element.tag directly, which xml.etree.ElementTree always normalizes to Clark notation regardless of source prefix/default-namespace usage -- wrote 2 new tests (test_obligation_qname_resolution.py) constructing the same Invoice document twice, once with a default namespace and once with an explicit prefix, proving identical resulting qnames and identical projected values.

3. SAL-UBL-OBL-0996E6D7B91D544F (reject namespace spoofing / ambiguous QName resolution with diagnostics): read model/typed.py's find()/find_all() directly and found they match children by local_name(child.qname) == name ONLY, never checking the expanded namespace. Verified this is a real, exploitable gap by direct construction: built a parent XmlNode with a spoofed {urn:evil:attacker:namespace}ID child placed before a real {urn:oasis:...:CommonBasicComponents-2}ID child, called find(parent, 'ID'), and confirmed it returned the spoofed element's text -- exactly the 'best-effort guessing' this obligation says must be rejected.

4. Assessed whether to fix this in-tick: find()/find_all() are the navigation primitives every typed accessor in the package routes through (amount_of, quantity_of, identifier_of, every aggregate-of function). A correct fix requires auditing and updating every call site across typed.py/aggregates.py/charges.py/reference.py/document.py to verify the expected namespace alongside the local name -- a cross-cutting change to a core primitive with real blast radius. Decided this exceeds a citation-audit tick's safe scope without dedicated design and regression coverage, and left it honestly `missing` with the precise, demonstrated finding rather than attempting a rushed fix that could destabilize the whole typed-projection layer, or silently ignoring/hiding it behind a generic placeholder.

5. Applied the patch-script pattern. Added the new UBL-PARSE-CITATION-AUDIT-SELECTOR-PROOF execution_evidence entry, validated the YAML parses (194 total obligations, PARSE-001 now 13 implemented / 10 partial / 6 missing), ran the reconciler cleanly, ran ruff on the new test file (clean), and ran the full ubl suite to confirm zero regressions beyond the 2 new tests.
